questions.why: Mike Mignola wrote and drew Hellboy, which Dark Horse Comics publishes.

questions.q: Hellboy's signature Right Hand of Doom is made of what material?

Bureau for Paranormal Research and Defense

questions.why: Bruttenholm named the infant and formally adopted him in March 1946.

questions.q: Which 1994 Dark Horse miniseries launched Hellboy's own series?
questions.why: Mignola and John Byrne made Seed of Destruction from March to June 1994.

questions.q: What is Hellboy's oversized revolver called in the 2004 and 2008 films?

questions.q: Who directed the 2004 Hellboy film and its 2008 sequel?
questions.why: Del Toro directed Hellboy and The Golden Army; the 2019 reboot had a different filmmaker.

questions.q: Which subtitle belongs to the 2024 live-action Hellboy film?

Devourer of Souls, Herald of the Final Doom
Destroyer of Worlds, Creator of Worlds
